p8.paths: every p8_files path is relative to the P8 root at this commit

gated.action: the same normalised world-frame velocity setpoint as the PPO teacher
gated.observation: P8's 25-d observation (it reads the fields it needs by name)
gated.p8_description: hover 0.3 m above the pad, commit on current-state dmf quiescence
gated.role: teacher in T_mix (mix_1000 demos with T_ppo; *_mix ablations); baseline row
gated.structure: Hover hover_height_m above the pad (P on the height error, capped), commit to pid_feedforward's descent when dmf's quiescence rule holds on the CURRENT deck state over the trailing sustain window. Gains loaded from pid_feedforward.yaml. Stateful.

oracle_gated.action: the same normalised world-frame velocity setpoint as the PPO teacher
oracle_gated.observation: P8's 25-d observation (it reads the fields it needs by name)
oracle_gated.p8_description: commit-timing oracle (privileged): commit on the true future quiescent window
oracle_gated.role: baseline row (privileged commit-timing oracle; never deployable)
oracle_gated.structure: gated's hover and commit, but the quiescence predicate is applied to the TRUE FUTURE deck states at the predicted touchdown time (privileged context). A commit-timing oracle, never a deployable result.

pid_feedforward.action: the same normalised world-frame velocity setpoint as the PPO teacher
pid_feedforward.observation: P8's 25-d observation (it reads the fields it needs by name)
pid_feedforward.p8_description: pid_track_descend + k_ff * pad velocity (ideal noise-free, zero-latency ship motion reference unit plus state estimate); residual base
pid_feedforward.role: teacher T_pid (pid_1000 demos; *_pid ablations); baseline row
pid_feedforward.structure: pid_track_descend's law plus k_ff x pad deck-point velocity (velocity + rel_velocity from the observation) on all three axes. Stateful (integrator, commit latch).

pid_track_descend.action: the same normalised world-frame velocity setpoint as the PPO teacher
pid_track_descend.observation: P8's 25-d observation (it reads the fields it needs by name)
pid_track_descend.p8_description: lateral PI, descend at a constant rate once laterally inside a radius
pid_track_descend.structure: Lateral PI on the pad-relative xy error (speed-capped, anti-windup clamp); descend at a constant rate once the lateral error is inside commit_radius_m (released beyond release_factor x radius), hold height otherwise. No deck feedforward. Stateful (integrator, commit latch).

action.space: Box(-1, 1, (3,)): normalised world-frame velocity setpoint, yaw held at 0

ppo.algorithm: stable-baselines3 PPO, MlpPolicy (ActorCriticPolicy), trained on CPU

normalisation.kind: SB3 VecNormalize, statistics frozen at evaluation (training=False)

parameters.derivation: from P8's config: net_arch for pi and vf, obs dim 25, action dim 3

ppo.role: teacher T_ppo (every T_ppo demo, DAgger/DART labels, modular's frozen policy)

training.steps_unit: env control steps of 1/30 s model scale

R1_lerobot_dp.note: not built here: LeRobot 0.6.1 DiffusionPolicy, trained in .venv-lerobot and flown from its ONNX export; see the config. Parameter counts are not derived by ila.
